description:
Oak Brotherhood

DOWNLOAD

Require :
LazyLib
Nexerelin
MagicLib

Other mods Integrations:
Industrial Evolution
Substance Abuse
Commisioned Crews
Music Switcher (Oak brotherhood has own unique combat music)

Introduction :
Spoiler
Hello, i play starsector for a long time. And i enjoy it. I also enjoyed many awesome mods over there. Someday i just randomly decided to just make my own mod, just for fun and maybe learn something. So i made this small project. I started with no knowledge(only some programming basics), no talent, no skill. SO i was slowly learning stuff step by step. Reading guides, watching guides, getting helps from some cool folks from discord server. And slowly started building something, step by step, either i reverse engineered code from other mods, either i asked people on discord for help. I got graphics and music by generating portraits and some pictures with AI (Bing create for pictures and suno.ai for music), also grabbed some sprites from Spiral Arms(God/Ludd bless all folks who put sprites there so talentless hacks like me can use them) and gave them a paintjob. And soon, Oak Brotherhood came to live. I hope you will enjoy my faction mod with space cowboys even if it cannot compete with masterpieces like UAF or Iron Shell.

For now this is a test release of faction. Not everything is perfect but i hope i will get from some useful feedback for improvement of my faction (including feedback about writing because i am from Poland and english is not my first language).  Also small warning, this mod contains few cursewords (Sometimes there is a reason for some characters to drop a F-Bomb).

This is more like a beta version, and a lot to change and improve. But i released it in hope to gether some opinion and suggestions.

What is Oak Brotherhood?:
Spoiler
Oak Brotherhood is a Faction that resides in abyssal hyperspace, near mysterious green star called "Quercus". It has 3 planets. Oak Brotherhood is made of 2 groups.
Scientists - Scientists, engineers, archeologists. They spend their time studying Quercus, reverse engineering technologies buried inside one of the planets and developing ships and weapons for Peackeepers or to sell them. Their experiments have questionable legality (because of using AI cores in these)
Peacekeepers - Military part of Oak Brotherhood, former mercenaries who decided to stay at Quercus and protect it from outside enemies (Mostly Pirates and Luddic path but also Hegemony since they find out that Oak Brotherhood Likes to use AI).

Oak Brotherhood's politics
Oak Brotherhood doesn't have any political structures. Simply scientists cooperate with Peacekeepers, all administrative stuff is given to AI cores. All colonies are controlled by AI administrator.

Oak Brotherhood's important characters

Stephan Steelhand

Stephan also known as "Sheriff of Quercus" is the leader of Peacekeepers. He was once an independent mercenary who came through many battles, Pirates, Pathers, [Redacted]. Now he is responsible for safety of Oak Brotherhood. He lost his limbs and some other parts of his body during many battles and now he has metal replacements. He will be Player's Military Contact.

Albert Hawking

Albert is a head scientist of Oak Brotherhood. All scientists, engineers and archeologists are under his management. He also keeps eye on Administrative AI in order to check Faction's economical needs and find someone who will fulfill them. He will be Player's Science and Trade contact.

Oak Brotherhood's ships and weapons
Spoiler
Oak Brotherhood's fleet doctrine is all around tanky hi tech ships able to perform burst of speed while strenghtening their shields in order to ram other ships and push them around and shoot beams at them between charges.

Oak Brotherhood's main ships are known as "Frontbreakers". they are durable but they lack mobility compared to other ships of their weight class. Their main gimmick is "Forntbreaker Manevuer" that shutdowns weapons, increases shield durability and increases engine power in order to perform charging attack. Frontbreaker ships bring element of chaos to battle because they can break formations by simply pushing enemy ships around. These ships are.

Hawthorn - Frontbreaker Frigate

Willow - Frontbreaker Destroyer

Buckeye - Frontbreaker Cruiser

Oak - Frontbreaker warship

Oak Brotherhood also has few other ships that sometimes can appear in their fleets.

Basswood - Assault frigate
Basswood is an frigate with teleport ability. They are good at flanking and using opportunity from chaos made by Frontbreaker Ships.

Beech - Hunter Killer Destroyer
Beech is a destroyer version of Baswood. Same role but with a bit more firepower and durability.

Magnolia - Shieldbuster Drone Tender.
Magnolia is a shepherd's cousin that is great aganist shields but is weak aganist anything else. Magnolia has built in gravitron beams and hullmod that makes it's beams deal hard flux. Magnolia also has 3 Shieldbuster Drones that also shoot gravitron beam.

Maple - Frontline Annoyance Frigate
Maple is the most rare ship that can be found Oak Brotherhood's fleets. It's an Oak Brotherhood's recreation of Monitor. Maple is a bit more durable and is armed with ion canons. Maple exists only to annoy/distract enemy ships by turning off their weapons and engines with EMP damage.

Birch - Area Denial Cruiser
Birch is the only ship in Oak Brotherhood that can actually defend aganist missiles. Birch's purpose is to keep other stuff from area around it, mostly fighters and missiles. Birch has built in hullmod that makes every energy weapon on it act like point defence weapon. Birch also can lay mines to keep a bit of pressure on guarded area.

Fir - Missile Cruiser
Fir is a definition of glass cannon. Slow and fragile. But Fir can shoot A LOT of missiles.

Cypress - Giant Transporter
Big and durable transporter, it is Tanker and Freighter in one, with some nice durability and its own unique cone-class droneship fighters instead of weapons in order to protect itself.

Weapons

Quercun Beams - Oak Brotherhood's basic weapons. Simple energy damage beams, in 3 sizes.

Sunbeam DEM Missiles - Missile weapons that shoot lasers, great for long range laser bombardment. Launchers come in 3 sizes.

Quercun Spreaders - Unique weapons that shoots energy projectiles in shotgun-like style. Great for close range combat. Comes in 3 sizes.

Starmass thrower - Flamethrower like weapon that is highly effective aganist shields.

Quercun Blaster - Very big laser, long cooldown and charge up but with satisfying effect of giant destructive beam.

Oak Brotherhood also has some Experimental Prototype Ships and weapons that it will never use. But Player can recieve these as a reward for good relations with faction and specific characters. Not to mention, player can unlock later an unique shop.
Credits
Spoiler
- Big thanks for people from starsector modmaking Discord.
- Especially big thanks to Turkler for a lot of advice and help around rules.csv and scripting.
- Music was created by using SUNO.AI
- Ingame illustrations and portraits are created by using Bing AI image generator.
- Sprites i got from Spiral arms
- Very big thanks to CuteyCai for designing Oak Brotherhood flag and Quercian Whiskey bottle(for substance abuse integration)

Changes
Spoiler
03.05.2024
- Mod was released (beta)

06.05.2024
- Made some balance changes.
List of changes
Spoiler
Quercus shield improvement
- Reduced shield bonus from 30% to 25%

Basswood
- Max flux reduced from 8000 to 5000
- Flux dissipation reduced from 800 to 300

Oak
- Flux dissipation reduced from 2000 to 1300

Magnolia
- Magnolia was made to appear more often in fleets

Frontbreaker Manevuer
- Cooldown increased from 8 to 10
- now also removes 15% of current flux

Yggdrassil
- Some weapon arcs tweaks

16.06.2024
- Released version 0.90, with new stuff.
List of changes
Spoiler
Update Codename: It's evil drone Season:

Well, first small warnings.
CAUTION - From now Oak Brotherhood requires Magic Lib
CAUTION - This update requires new game to have everything applies.
I added some stuff from Magic lib therefore it is now required. Also i added some stuff related to new game generation, so you have to start a new game to make update fully apply and be sure you wont have any problems.

NEW STUFF
Of course lets talk Oak Brotherhood's fleet doctrine. It will be fully focused on frontbreaker ships that will make a majority of Oak Brotherhood's fleets. With occasional non-frontbreaker ships around. And thanks to new weapons i can truly make frontbreaker ships self suffcent without need of outside specialized ship. Of course these specialised ships can be met from time to time. Turning Oak Brotherhood into recklessly fighting hi tech faction that just loves satysfying charges into enemy fleets. Of course to make frontbreaker complete, i added Hawthorn, frontbreaker frigate so ever size class has frontbreaker ship. Second ship is Beech, a bigger baswood. And Oak Brotherhood also has its own unique CIvilian ship, works as both giant Tanker and Freighter with insane durability, has no weapons but instead it uses drone fighters to defend itself.
And speaking of weapons. Oak Brotherhood all what had was Quercun Beams and Sunbeam missiles.  But it was not enough, and i got some quite unique ideas and added some new tools of violence. Quercun spreader, for direct combat, starmass thrower to screw over shields and Quercun Blaster, big lazor.

Ships:

Hawthorn - Frontbreaker frigate, my little armored fire breathing Chihuaua, Hawthorn will definitely charge alongside it's older brothers into enemy fleet. Because why not.

Beech - hunter Killer Destroyer, when enemy fleet is busy with other ships, Beech can teleport behind you the same way as basswood does, but with more guns.

Cypress -  Giant Transporter, Did someone said "I need more space for fuel and supplies"? No problem Fella, this Bad boy can fit so many Supplies and Fuel. Also why make transporters so squishy when you can make it durable enough to just sit here and wait untill rest of fleet deals with Pirates and other fans of someone else's belongings. Of course Cypress can release droneship fighters just to deal with nuissances.

Weapons:

Quercun spreader series - Well, i always wanted laser shotgun, and it technically works like shotgun. It spreads projectiles in cone. Of course it's most effective at close range. And the bigger it is, the more projectiles it shoots.

Starmass Thrower - It shoots mass of electromagnetic energy (because its sci-fi science), it deals some EMP but most important it is effective aganist energetic forcefields, like ship shields.

Quercun Blaster - B.F.LAZOR. It takes quite hefty chunk of time to charge up, but when it shoots. Oh boy. It shoots devastating beam with insane range, perfect for finishing retreating overfluxed radiant.

Hullmods:

Frontbreaker plating optimization - Frontbreaker ship unique hullmod. Basically increases effective armor for damage reduction calculations. Stronger on smaller ships, weaker on bigger ships.

Buildings:
Well if you think its is over of new stuff. Well You are wrong. Because Oak Brotherhood Planets also got some wonderful Oak Brotherhood unique stuff. 2 unique constructions.

Peacekeeper Saloon - Well i liked how some factions (Like Sindran Diktat, or modded factions) have unique military building. And so i decided to make one for Oak Brotherhood, that will fit Faction's lore more. But i just cant add "Oak Brotherhood military center" or similar kind of stuff, that wont fit Peacekeepers at all. But what if i make something like a Tavern with place to sleep and some fleet management systems attached to it in backrooms? Well it should fit more. Therefore we have "Peacekeeper Saloon" where peacekeepers spend most of their free time (If they are not getting drunk near giant oak). Also sometimes mercenary marines come here for Quercian Whiskey, thats why Saloon generates marines.

Planetary Forge - Oak Forge is basically one giant production facility from old times, this is not a planet with Orbital works. Entire Planet is an Orbital Works but bigger. This building should make Oak Forge mechanic more close to its lore. Massive facilities able to produce everything including high quality ships for Peacekeeper needs, toothbrushes and new mechanical hands for Sheriff.

Audiovisual changes

New Faction Flag:

Lets start with something that will be easiest to notice. Oak Brotherhood got a new Flag. Designed by CuteyCai. She made a great job making it.

Ship changes

Oak got a small repainting. Old Oak was just too green. So i added more colors.

Oak Brotherhood now has unique engine and shield color instead of vanilla hi-tech style.

Frontbreaker manevuer also has unique effect on ship shields and engines.

Music
Changed faction's market music. What i can say, some cool harmonica stuff if you are not hostile. But harmonica is not there when you are hostile, nobody plays harmonica when there is violence time.

Bounty Board (magiclib)
Added some Faction's unique bounties to Intel bounty board.
- Experimental droneship escaped Quercus and Oak Brotherhood needs someone to get it and destroy it before it causes troubles.
- Evil drone hunting competitions, for all seasoned dronehunters, you can win money and grab some nice alpha cores.
- some really weird pirate managed to steal ships that took a great part in Oak Brotherhood's history. Oak Brotherhood will gladly pay money to anyone who will make sure that Pirate will realize how terrible mistake he made. Outside of stolen beefed up capitals that Pirate also has his own unique flagship, so make sure you have a strong fleet to face him, outside of good payment you can also get that unique flaghip for yourself. Good Luck Fella

Integrations
Yes, Oak Brotherhood now has integration with some other mods. YAY

Industrial Evolution
Oak Brotherhood now will have added Industrial Evolution unique buildings if you have Industrial Evolution (sadly to make changes work you must start a new game after mod's update).

Music Switcher
Oak Brotherhood will have its own battle theme if you have that mod installed. (You will listen to this banger while frontbreaker ships ram into your fleet.)

Commisioned Crews
If you get commisioned to Oak Brotherhood, you will recieve some nice bonus to hull, armor and flux capacity.
Spoiler

Substance Abuse

Well, i mentioned Quercian Whiskey in Oak Brotherhood (Like when Sheriff drinks it during some dialogues). If you have Substance Abuse, you can now drink it with your crew. This wonderful booze will improve your hi tech direct combat.
Big thanks to CuteyCai for bottle design.

Balance Changes
- Greatly reduced tankiness of non-frontbreaker ships (Mostly basswood)
- Changed a bit effectivness of Quercus Defensive improvement hullmod, most notable change is reduced hard flux dissapation on smaller ships.
- Some tweaks of frontbreaker ships shields, armor and hull.
- Oak Brotherhood Markets have reduced size.
- Reworked "Ai battle nobody heard about" non campaign mission, now it is one mission with some decent challenge.

05.04.2025
- Released version 0.91
List of changes
Spoiler
Update Codename: Killer ship and pet drone:

I dont guarantee that update is fully save compatible. If you already played with this mod but you didnt started any special Oak Brotherhood related events, you should be fine i guess. But i advise to just start a new game.

This one update will add not much compared to previous one. Simply lack of ideas that i am able to implement.

- Reworked conditions to unlock special secret shop(It involves content from starsector 0.98a). Unlocking special shop also makes Oak Brotherhood more fortified.
Well i dont know how many of you already unlocked it, but well, one little thing you can get from 0,98 content gave me one idea so i expanded a bit requirements you need to meet in order to unlock the secret shop. Also i added something more. If you unlock secret shop, Oak Brotherhood will also get more fortified.

If you want to figure out how to get secret shop by yourself go for it, if you dont then there is hidden in spoiler instruction how to unlock it

Spoiler
- Commision yourself to Oak Brotherhood
- Get very high relation with Stephan Steelhand and Oak Brotherhood, if you get high enough amount, next time you talk with Sheriff, he will give you one of special ships.
- Get very high relation with Albert Hawking and Oak Brotherhood, if you get high enough, next time you talk with Albert, he will give you 2 special weapons.
- Once you get both ship and weapons, visit Giant Oak at The Grand Oak. Peacekeepers will invite you to party, go party with them.
- Go talk To Albert Hawking after events that happened at the giant Oak.
- Get Onslaught Mk1 and talk to Sheriff, he will notice it, tell him that this onslaught is in fact very special. He will advise you to bring it to Albert.
- Go to Albert and discuss about funny onslaught.
- After that open connection with Albert again. After a small talk you will unlock a special shop.

- Added new non Campaign Mission "Sheriff and his Steed".

- Fixed some spelling mistakes

- Sheriff now will react to unique ships in your fleet.
Spoiler
He will notice your ziggy

28.09.2025
- Released version 0.91a
List of changes
Spoiler
Update codename: No codename, just hotfix.

- Removed bug that caused system background dont change on other system when leaving quercus
- Small tweaks of ship balance, mostly around crew amount to be more lore fitting.
- Small tweaks around fleet compositions.
- Added an older version of oak (these will occasionally appear on Oak Brotherhood fleets)
- Made some tweaks in descriptions and tags (To support new codex)
- Fixed some naming issues (that cause problems on linux)

changelog.0.90:
Update Codename: It's evil drone Season:

 Well, first small warnings.
 CAUTION - From now Oak Brotherhood requires Magic Lib
CAUTION - This update requires new game to have everything applies.
 I added some stuff from Magic lib therefore it is now required. Also i added some stuff related to new game generation, so you have to start a new game to make update fully apply and be sure you wont have any problems.

 NEW STUFF
 Of course lets talk Oak Brotherhood's fleet doctrine. It will be fully focused on frontbreaker ships that will make a majority of Oak Brotherhood's fleets. With occasional non-frontbreaker ships around. And thanks to new weapons i can truly make frontbreaker ships self suffcent without need of outside specialized ship. Of course these specialised ships can be met from time to time. Turning Oak Brotherhood into recklessly fighting hi tech faction that just loves satysfying charges into enemy fleets. Of course to make frontbreaker complete, i added Hawthorn, frontbreaker frigate so ever size class has frontbreaker ship. Second ship is Beech, a bigger baswood. And Oak Brotherhood also has its own unique CIvilian ship, works as both giant Tanker and Freighter with insane durability, has no weapons but instead it uses drone fighters to defend itself.
And speaking of weapons. Oak Brotherhood all what had was Quercun Beams and Sunbeam missiles.  But it was not enough, and i got some quite unique ideas and added some new tools of violence. Quercun spreader, for direct combat, starmass thrower to screw over shields and Quercun Blaster, big lazor.

 Ships:

Hawthorn - Frontbreaker frigate, my little armored fire breathing Chihuaua, Hawthorn will definitely charge alongside it's older brothers into enemy fleet. Because why not.

Beech - hunter Killer Destroyer, when enemy fleet is busy with other ships, Beech can teleport behind you the same way as basswood does, but with more guns.

Cypress -  Giant Transporter, Did someone said "I need more space for fuel and supplies"? No problem Fella, this Bad boy can fit so many Supplies and Fuel. Also why make transporters so squishy when you can make it durable enough to just sit here and wait untill rest of fleet deals with Pirates and other fans of someone else's belongings. Of course Cypress can release droneship fighters just to deal with nuissances.

 Weapons:

Quercun spreader series - Well, i always wanted laser shotgun, and it technically works like shotgun. It spreads projectiles in cone. Of course it's most effective at close range. And the bigger it is, the more projectiles it shoots.

Starmass Thrower - It shoots mass of electromagnetic energy (because its sci-fi science), it deals some EMP but most important it is effective aganist energetic forcefields, like ship shields.

Quercun Blaster - B.F.LAZOR. It takes quite hefty chunk of time to charge up, but when it shoots. Oh boy. It shoots devastating beam with insane range, perfect for finishing retreating overfluxed radiant.

 Hullmods:

Frontbreaker plating optimization - Frontbreaker ship unique hullmod. Basically increases effective armor for damage reduction calculations. Stronger on smaller ships, weaker on bigger ships.

 Buildings:
 Well if you think its is over of new stuff. Well You are wrong. Because Oak Brotherhood Planets also got some wonderful Oak Brotherhood unique stuff. 2 unique constructions.

Peacekeeper Saloon - Well i liked how some factions (Like Sindran Diktat, or modded factions) have unique military building. And so i decided to make one for Oak Brotherhood, that will fit Faction's lore more. But i just cant add "Oak Brotherhood military center" or similar kind of stuff, that wont fit Peacekeepers at all. But what if i make something like a Tavern with place to sleep and some fleet management systems attached to it in backrooms? Well it should fit more. Therefore we have "Peacekeeper Saloon" where peacekeepers spend most of their free time (If they are not getting drunk near giant oak). Also sometimes mercenary marines come here for Quercian Whiskey, thats why Saloon generates marines.

Planetary Forge - Oak Forge is basically one giant production facility from old times, this is not a planet with Orbital works. Entire Planet is an Orbital Works but bigger. This building should make Oak Forge mechanic more close to its lore. Massive facilities able to produce everything including high quality ships for Peacekeeper needs, toothbrushes and new mechanical hands for Sheriff.

 Audiovisual changes

 New Faction Flag:

Lets start with something that will be easiest to notice. Oak Brotherhood got a new Flag. Designed by CuteyCai. She made a great job making it.

 Ship changes

Oak got a small repainting. Old Oak was just too green. So i added more colors.

Oak Brotherhood now has unique engine and shield color instead of vanilla hi-tech style.

Frontbreaker manevuer also has unique effect on ship shields and engines.

 Music
Changed faction's market music. What i can say, some cool harmonica stuff if you are not hostile. But harmonica is not there when you are hostile, nobody plays harmonica when there is violence time.

 Bounty Board (magiclib)
Added some Faction's unique bounties to Intel bounty board.
- Experimental droneship escaped Quercus and Oak Brotherhood needs someone to get it and destroy it before it causes troubles.
- Evil drone hunting competitions, for all seasoned dronehunters, you can win money and grab some nice alpha cores.
- some really weird pirate managed to steal ships that took a great part in Oak Brotherhood's history. Oak Brotherhood will gladly pay money to anyone who will make sure that Pirate will realize how terrible mistake he made. Outside of stolen beefed up capitals that Pirate also has his own unique flagship, so make sure you have a strong fleet to face him, outside of good payment you can also get that unique flaghip for yourself. Good Luck Fella

 Integrations
 Yes, Oak Brotherhood now has integration with some other mods. YAY

 Industrial Evolution
Oak Brotherhood now will have added Industrial Evolution unique buildings if you have Industrial Evolution (sadly to make changes work you must start a new game after mod's update).

 Music Switcher
Oak Brotherhood will have its own battle theme if you have that mod installed. (You will listen to this banger while frontbreaker ships ram into your fleet.)

 Commisioned Crews
If you get commisioned to Oak Brotherhood, you will recieve some nice bonus to hull, armor and flux capacity.
 Spoiler

 Substance Abuse

Well, i mentioned Quercian Whiskey in Oak Brotherhood (Like when Sheriff drinks it during some dialogues). If you have Substance Abuse, you can now drink it with your crew. This wonderful booze will improve your hi tech direct combat.
Big thanks to CuteyCai for bottle design.

 Balance Changes
- Greatly reduced tankiness of non-frontbreaker ships (Mostly basswood)
- Changed a bit effectivness of Quercus Defensive improvement hullmod, most notable change is reduced hard flux dissapation on smaller ships.
- Some tweaks of frontbreaker ships shields, armor and hull.
- Oak Brotherhood Markets have reduced size.
- Reworked "Ai battle nobody heard about" non campaign mission, now it is one mission with some decent challenge.
